data.narrative:
Terra Industries is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $34M to date. The comparable universe consists of 10 private companies and 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS), with three same-sector, same-stage private comps informing peer analysis: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two valuation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $34M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, implying a $68M valuation. The peer-median approach anchors to the three same-sector, same-stage comparables, yielding a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects material heterogeneity in company maturity, technology differentiation, or market positioning within Defense & Security at this stage.

Triangulating these two methods produces a range of $58M to $460M, with a median estimate of $234M. The stage-progression method floor of $68M likely reflects insufficient adjustment for the sector premium or founder credibility. The peer-median ceiling of $400M reflects the median comp directly. Key uncertainties include the composition and representativeness of the three-company peer set, particularly the influence of the $4.0B outlier (Stark Defence), and whether Terra's current traction and IP position warrant valuation toward the upper or lower quartile of the peer distribution.
